name: fff-search
description: Floating fuzzy search over your workspace, backed by a resident fff index.

fffSearch.maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches returned per search.

fffSearch.useExcludeSettings.description: Apply `search.exclude` and `files.exclude` to the index, so anything you have hidden from search is never indexed. Changing either list rebuilds the index.

fffSearch.maxMatchesPerFile.description: Maximum matches kept from a single file, so one huge file cannot fill the list.

fffSearch.smartCase.description: Case-insensitive while the query is lowercase, case-sensitive once it contains an uppercase letter. Turn off to always ignore case.

enumDescriptions: Literal first; when it finds nothing, retry fuzzy automatically. Costs a second pass, but only on zero-hit queries that finished inside 60% of the time budget.
Literal only; a zero-hit query offers a fuzzy retry you accept with Enter.
fffSearch.fuzzy.description: When to use fuzzy matching. Fuzzy ranks by edit distance rather than containment, so a literal hit is not guaranteed to rank first.

fffSearch.timeBudgetMs.description: Wall-clock budget per search in milliseconds. grep runs synchronously on the extension host, so a larger budget returns more complete results but blocks the picker for longer.

fffSearch.maxFileSizeMb.description: Files larger than this are skipped.

fffSearch.persistFrecency.description: Store fff's frecency and query history in the extension's global storage, so files you actually open rank higher in later sessions.

fffSearch.preview.description: Preview the highlighted match in the editor behind the picker while moving through results.

fffSearch.restoreEditorOnDismiss.description: When the picker is dismissed without picking a result, return to the editor, cursor and scroll position you were in before it opened.

fffSearch.eagerIndex.description: Start building the index for the first workspace folder when the window opens, so the first search is already warm. Costs a few tens of MB of memory per indexed folder (~26 MB for 14k files) even if the picker is never opened.

fffSearch.definitionsFirst.description: Rank lines the SDK classifies as definitions above the rest. The classifier is a line heuristic (function, class, interface, type, enum, def, func …): a definition written as `const x = factory(...)` is not recognised. Grouped mode keeps file order.

fffSearch.seedFromSelection.description: Use the current editor selection as the initial query.
